description:
"Focus your body and mind into a meditative state, healing for |cffffff1836|r Health and restoring |cffffff1500|r Magicka and Stamina every |cffffff1|r second.

Maintaining the channel increases the Health restored by |cffffff10|r% every tick, up to a maximum of |cffffff50|r%.

You will remain in a meditative state until you toggle this ability off or are interrupted."
